26" Electric Commuter Bike

· Hi-ten Step-thru Frame – Lightweight, sturdy and easier to get on and off.
· LCD Display - Real-time monitoring of ride-related data.
· 36V 250W Motor - Provide sufficient power.
· 50 Miles Max Range - Offers a longer ride.

· Dual Disc Brakes & Lights - Fully ensure rider's safety.
· Suspension Front Fork - Smoother and more comfortable riding experience.
· Non-Slip Tire - Adapts to a variety of terrains

Sturdy and Smart

Hiland hi-ten steel frame is lightweight and durable, and its step-thru style makes riders easy to stand up and get on and off.

Stay informed and in control with its intuitive LCD display, you can easily monitor your speed, battery life, distance traveled and choose from 5 pedal assist levels to ensure a personalized and optimized riding experience.

It can also be connected and controlled via smart app for better monitoring, which ensures you can enjoy the convenience of electric assistance with the companion app "Smart Life."

Strong and Long-lasting Power

Equipped with a stable 250W motor providing 5 modes to 20MPH max. Fully enclosed waterproof and dustproof IPX6.

Sufficient capacity to travel up to 50 miles on a single charge, providing you with long-lasting ride. Plus, this removable battery is easy to charge and replace on the go.

Guarantee of Safety

The responsive disc brakes with automatic power cut-off provide reliable stopping power, ensuring your safety and control on any terrain.

Also, it does not damage the rim. Therefore, it provides you better durability and stopping power.

The equipped lights on this ebike enhance visibility, ensuring that you remain visible to others on the road, especially during low-light conditions or at night.

Comfortable Riding

Front suspension fork absorbs any bumps and dips encountered on your path, which can help cyclists ride comfortably and effortlessly over varied terrain.

Its non-slip tires has strong grip and puncture resistance. Dual-wall rims allow them to withstand high-intensity riding and protect the inner tube from rupture.

Assembly & Multiple Color

Instructions and assembly tools included, easy to assemble within 30 minutes.

About Hiland

Hiland is a bicycle brand developed by Joykie. Since 1997, Joykie has delivered bicycle products to more than 80 countries around the world, delivering over 40 million bicycles in total.

Hiland has always been about getting people on the bike and exploring the paths around them. With Hiland, we hope everyone has as much fun cycling as we do.
